data.description:
SURFACE: /roster?person=... (organizer speaker record), 'Speaker files' region; and /files.

WHAT BREAKS: A headshot a speaker uploads through their portal is stored and rendered as the /onboarding row avatar, but the organizer has no filename, uploader, timestamp or download for it anywhere. The record's 'Speaker files' region is an empty labelled section, and /files is scoped to file-request tasks only (it reported 'Received 0 of 159').

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed at live sha 75b871d94c6f) -- src/ui/speakers/SpeakerRecord.tsx:204-205:
    {/* Reserved for MRQ-112's speaker files panel; it owns the serve path and the render. */}
    <section class="speaker-section speaker-files" aria-label="Speaker files" />
A self-closing section with no children. The panel was never built, so the surface ships an empty region that announces itself to assistive technology as 'Speaker files'.

BOARD ACCURACY NOTE: MRQ-112 ('Headshots render and speaker files panel') is marked done. It closed with this placeholder still in the tree. Linking this ticket to MRQ-112 rather than reopening it, per operator ruling.

FIX SHAPE: render the speaker's profile-photo and portal uploads in that section (filename, uploader, timestamp, download), or fold profile photos into the deliverables model so /files can show them. Decide which of the two file systems owns profile photos -- today they are separate and only the deliverables one is surfaced.

WHY URGENT: 'the system does the chase work' is a stated principle; an organizer who cannot see what a speaker sent cannot stop chasing it.

SIZE: medium.

PROVENANCE: sbek run 2026-08-12T15-33-34, speaker-management judgement, defects[1]. Validated by reading live source.
data.title: The organizer's Speaker files panel ships as an empty placeholder

data.body:
LIVE VALIDATION — real artifact, not just green tests.

Built the worker (`npx vite build`) and ran it via `wrangler dev` on :8801 against a freshly
migrated + seeded local D1, at commit ede2f167. `/health` reported build `ede2f1675f58`.

**Speaker side**, through the real upload lifecycle the portal uses:

    POST /api/v1/me/uploads/sign  {ownerType: person_headshot, ownerId: per_aarush-selvan} -> 200
    PUT the actual JPEG bytes (66,317 B) via LOCAL_UPLOAD_SHIM -> 200
    POST /api/v1/me/uploads/{id}/complete -> status ready
    PATCH /api/v1/me/profile {headshot_attachment_id} -> pointer written

(No browser file-picker: WKWebView cannot set a file input. Everything the portal's client
calls was called, in order, with real bytes.)

**Organizer side**, in a real browser (c11 WKWebView, signed in as organizer via the demo
persona), at `/roster?person=per_aarush-selvan`. The Files section now reads:

    FILES
    0 of 1 requested file received.

    Profile photo                              Uploaded by the speaker
      aarush-selvan-headshot.jpg   V1 OF 1   uploaded Aug 12, 2026 at 4:22 PM   64.8 KB
      Download   Copy link

    Presentation Upload      Due Aug 31, 2026 · Going deep on Gemini Deep Research
      Nothing uploaded against this request yet.

Filename, uploader, timestamp, size, and a download control — the ticket's minimum bar, met,
on the surface the ticket names. Before this commit that region was a self-closing
`<section aria-label="Speaker files" />` with no children at all.

Empty state checked on a second speaker (`per_aie-code-2025-alex-gavrilescu`): "No profile
photo uploaded yet." plus the outstanding request. No empty labelled void either way.

**One honest limitation.** The Download href is a capability URL on the media origin, built
by the shared `publicMediaUrl` helper that `/files` and the portal already use. Under
`wrangler dev` it cannot be fetched locally — wrangler rewrites Host to the deployed custom
domain, so `isMediaHost()` never matches a loopback request. That is a property of local
media serving, identical for the existing files library, not of this change. The URL string
was verified to be the same shape the library emits for the same attachment.

**Design decision, stated explicitly** (the ticket asked for one): option (a). Profile
photos stay their own owner type; the speaker record unions the two owners at read time.
Folding photos into the deliverables model would mean minting a synthetic file-request task
per person, which changes what `/files` counts as expected and what the chase board owes —
a data-model change with the deadline hours away, for no gain on this surface.

**Incidental finding, NOT part of this ticket:** the local seed creates zero `task_upload`
attachments (40 `submission_file` rows plus the one headshot I uploaded), which is why
`/files` reports "Received 0 of 153" on seeded data. The evaluator read that as a defect in
the library; it is at least partly a defect in the seed. Worth someone's attention
separately.

Merged as 2dfd378a — PR #125, squashed into main, branch deleted.

Independent review (a separate agent, not the author) came back substantially clean:
authorization correct and consistent with sibling routes, SQL join-for-join equivalent to
files.queries.ts with no N+1 and no D1 bind hazard, CLAUDE.md rules honoured, no secrets.
Two pre-merge items raised and both taken:

- The authorization test did not test authorization. Now asserts that a speaker seat
  (speaker:write, no program:read) gets 403 reading another speaker's files — the claim
  that actually matters for a route handing out capability URLs.
- An unreachable empty-state branch removed: listVersionsForOwners answers for every
  requested owner, so groups.length === 0 could never be true.

Also fixed a copy contradiction the review surfaced: the photo row read "Uploaded by the
speaker" directly above "No profile photo uploaded yet."

CI caught one thing the local gate never reached, because the suite failed on load before
trace:ac ran: test titles must start with 'AC-<n> · ' or 'CONTRACT · ' to bind to an
acceptance criterion, and 'REGRESSION · ' matched neither. Re-titled; fast-gate green in
4m46s, which includes the full suite that could not complete locally under load ~200.

Follow-up material from the review, deliberately not done tonight: type the response schema
(z.unknown() today), hoist the panel's fetch so it does not serialise behind the record's
load (R7), and the .then-without-aborted-check race that is house style across
SpeakerRecord too — fix both or neither.

Process finding worth more than the ticket: git stash is SHARED across every worktree in
this repo (linked worktrees share one .git; refs/stash lives there). Two agents stashing
concurrently swap stacks and each silently loses their own work while acquiring a
stranger's. This happened twice within one minute on 2026-08-12 between MRQ-136 and
MRQ-138; both recovered from dangling commits via git fsck. The rule and its recovery path
are now in CLAUDE.md, shipped in this PR.

Independent review by a separate agent (not the author): substantially clean, no must-fix defect. Verified authorization is correct and consistent with the sibling routes (a speaker seat holds speaker:write and no program:read, so it 403s), the SQL mirrors files.queries.ts join-for-join with no N+1 and no D1 bind hazard, CLAUDE.md data-model rules honoured, no secrets or internals. Two items raised pre-merge, both taken: the authorization test now actually asserts the 403 rather than only 401/404, and an unreachable empty-state branch was removed. CI fast-gate green in 4m46s including the full suite that could not complete locally under load ~200. Merged as 2dfd378a (PR #125). Validated live against the built worker under wrangler dev: a headshot pushed through the speaker portal's real upload lifecycle now appears on the organizer's record with filename, timestamp, size and a download control, and a speaker who has sent nothing gets an honest sentence instead of an empty labelled region.
